description:
Add SVG images to Maui and native apps. 
			
			It's a Full .NET native implementation (it has no dependency).
			
			It supports .net9 and maui apps.
releaseNotes:
This package supports both Maui apps and native apps.

			Sample use and documentation:
			https://github.com/vapolia/Svg-Samples

			This library has no dependency on SkiaSharp, and uses only hardware accelerated low level platform calls.
			It is fast, small, and reliable.
			
			It does not support SVG masks: make sure you save your SVGs as optimized (see documentation on github) so masks are transformed into simple paths.
			It does not support text rendering, nor non-vector bitmaps.

			Commercial support is available at https://vapolia.eu

            1.0.8
            This release focus on getting a stable, fully featured Windows version.
            Changes:
            
            DisconnectHandler was explicitely called on Unload, this is not necessary with net9 and triggers issues on Windows. Removed.
            
            Windows support:
            - all gradients are supported
            - SvgImageSource is supported
            
            Known issues on Windows:
            - delay loaded icons in list items don't appear until the page is "refreshed". A workaround is to set IsLoadAsync to false.
            - calStripes.svg appears with an incorrect frame, in specific conditions to be determined. The demo projects triggers that issue when that svg is not the 1st one loaded.
            
			1.0.7
			A gradient referenced with: url("#id") (with double quotes) is now correctly applied on all platforms.
			iOS is now drawing gradients in strokes. They were missing.
			iOS now correctly draws the stroke, even if a gradient was set previously in fill, and fill is explicitly set to none.
			
			1.0.6
			net9 only. Use 1.0.5 for net8 support.
			update nugets
			linecaps are now correct on all platforms, they were mixed up
			
			1.0.5
			update nugets
			Minimum android version is now API 23 (was API 21)

			1.0.4
			maui: fix crash when infinite space is available. fix invisible crash on android when used in tab's icons.
			Breaking change: FillMode is renamed Aspect to align with maui names and make the discovery of that property easier
			Breaking change: measurement was reworked on maui so it now obeys more intuitively to HorizontalAligment, VerticalAligment and Aspect
			Update maui version
			Remove dependency on Maui Compatibility
			
			1.0.2
			Fix crash on Android when the handler is disconnected

			1.0.1
			Initial Maui release.
			See the Vapolia.Xamarin.Svg.Forms and Vapolia.Xamarin.Svg packages for the legacy Xamarin versions.
title: Svg vector image support for Maui (ios, mac, android, Windows)
